  * * [Nitrogen][6]
      * [eNhance™ – Sulfur-based additive to improve nitrogen usability.][7]

      * [PrimAgro N® – Nitrogen biofertilizer with beneficial microbes for soil conditioning.][10]
    * [Phosphorus][11]
      * [PrimAgro P® – Phosphorus biofertilizer with beneficial microbes to restore soil
        biology.][12]
      * [Pro-Germinator® – Versatile phosphorus fertilizer with nitrogen, potassium, and
        micronutrients.][13]
      * [Monty’s Premium Blend – Get crops out of the ground faster and keep them moving.][14]
      * [SpringuP – Phosphorus fertilizer starter to jumpstart the growing season.][15]

      * [Kalibrate® – Proven combination potassium and sulfur fertilizer.][17]
      * [Kapitalize – Unique, in-season potassium fertilizer with added sulfur and calcium.][18]

      * [Sure-K® – Safe, versatile potassium solution for any coping system or management
        practice.][20]

      * [AccesS – Economical and responsible sulfur fertilizer with nitrogen and
        micronutrients.][21]
      * [CalSip™ – Calcium and Sulfur fertilizer to help plants reach growth potential.][22]
      * [LiberateCa – Calcium fertilizer to prevent calcium deficiency and improve growth.][23]
      * [Magnesium – Magnesium fertilizer to promote chlorophyll production.][24]
    * [Micronutrient Fertilizers][25]
      * [Boron – Boron fertilizer to safely correct boron deficiencies and prevent crop damage.][26]
      * [Copper – Copper fertilizer to prevent copper deficiencies and improve leaf health.][27]
      * [Iron – Iron fertilizer to correct iron deficiencies, even in alkaline soils.][28]
      * [Manganese – Manganese fertilizer to correct deficiencies and improve nutrient intake.][29]
      * [microLink Iron HPH – MicroLink Iron HPH is specially formulated for producers with high pH
        or alkaline soils who experience iron chlorosis in their crops.][30]
      * [Moly – Molybdenum fertilizer to correct deficiencies and prevent deformations.][31]
      * [Zinc – Zinc fertilizer to correct deficiencies and prevent stunted growth.][32]
    * Micronutrient Packages
      * [Micro 400 – Micronutrient fertilizer with copper, iron, manganese and zinc.][33]
      * [Micro 500 – Micronutrient fertilizer with copper, iron, manganese, zinc, and boron.][34]
      * [Micro 600 – Micronutrient fertilizer with copper, iron, manganese, zinc, boron, and the
        secondary nutrient sulfur.][35]
      * [Micro 1000 – Micronutrient fertilizer with copper, iron, manganese, zinc, boron, nickel,
        molybdenum, cobalt, and the secondary nutrients calcium and magnesium.][36]
    * Multinutrient
      * [Fase1™ – Combination fertilizer to support early growth in young trees and bushes.][37]
      * [Fase2™ – Combination fertilizer to support robust budding and flowering in trees and
        bushes.][38]
      * [Fase3™ – Combination fertilizer to support strong fruiting in trees and bushes.][39]
      * [FertiRain – Versatile, multi-nutrient fertilizer to improve plant growth and
        production.][40]
    * [Biofertilizers][41]
      * [PrimAgro N® – Plant-usable nitrogen and sulfur with beneficial microbes which naturally
        promote N utilization and water intake.][42]
      * [PrimAgro P® – Phosphorus biofertilizer with additional nutrients and beneficial
        microbes.][43]
      * [PrimAgro K® – Potassium, nitrogen, and sulfur biofertilizer with beneficial microbes.][44]
      * [PrimAgro C-Tech – Restores vital microbial activity to improve soil and plant health.][45]
    * Humic & Fulvic Products
      * [AgroLiquid Fulvic – Fulvic acid fertilizer adding carbon compounds for soil fertility.][46]
      * [F-Tech – Fulvic acid fertilizer adding carbon compounds for soil fertility.][47]
      * [Montys Drivas Fulvic – Helps you get more performance out of every nutrient application and
        protect your yield potential.][48]

        improving nutrient availability and movement into the plant.][49]

## About Koppert

The answers to many of today’s agricultural and environmental challenges are already out there: in
nature itself. At Koppert, we explore, understand, and apply these natural solutions in partnership
with nature. Using natural enemies to control pests, bumblebees for pollination, and microbials that
support, protect, and strengthen crops. Improving plant health both above and underground. Since
1967, we’ve been helping growers worldwide cultivate healthier crops with high-quality biological
crop protection.

Nutrien is a leading global provider of crop inputs and services. We operate a world-class network
of production, distribution and ag retail facilities that positions us to efficiently serve the
needs of farmers. We focus on creating long-term value by prioritizing investments that strengthen
the advantages of our business across the ag value chain and by maintaining access to the resources
and relationships with stakeholders needed to achieve our goals.

the advantages of our business across the ag value chain and by maintaining access to the resources

## Welcome to AGENSO

We are a Leading Company in developing solutions for increased sustainability

AGENSO (Agricultural and Environmental Solutions) is an innovative company for agriculture and
environment, and its team is composed of highly motivated and qualified people that hold degrees in
agricultural engineering, information technology and environmental management.

AGENSO expertise spans in IoT solutions and Precision Agriculture (PA) services and specializes in
the promotion of research and services in the areas of sustainable agricultural production,
environmental sustainability and advanced technologies for agriculture and environment; being
in-line with the objectives set by EU with the 7^{th} Environment Action Programme.

## Solutions & Services

##### Farming Solutions

Support decision making through multi-platform apps for a more robust farm management and crop
growing control in a sustainable and environmental friendly way

##### Environmental Solutions

Doing more with less for taking care of the environment and protecting biodiversity and ecosystems

Precision Agriculture, Environmental and Research services for organizations, businesses,
cooperatives, farmers and individuals

The food and beverage industry is one of the most water- and energy-intensive industries in the

technologies.

[Hydrousa (H2020)]

### Hydrousa (H2020)

Demonstration of water loops with innovative regenerative business models for the Mediterranean
region
This project aims to revolutionise water value chains in Mediterranean areas and beyond, by
providing innovative nature-based water management solutions, which will close water loops and boost
the agricultural and energy profile of these areas. AGENSO is responsible for the development of:
* an online monitoring and controlling platform for water loops
* an automated system for optimizing irrigation at agricultural sites based on open source
  technologies
* a serious game for disseminating the project results
[OPTIMA (H2020)]

### OPTIMA (H2020)

Optimised Pest Integrated Management to precisely detect and control plant diseases in perennial
crops and open-field vegetables
OPTIMA will develop an environmentally friendly IPM framework for vineyards, apple orchards and
carrots by providing a holistic integrated approach which includes all critical aspects related to
integrated disease management, such as:
* novel bio-PPPs use
* disease prediction models
* spectral early disease detection systems
* precision spraying techniques
AGENSO is responsible for the development of an innovative DSS with optimized disease prediction
models, using agro-climatic and biological algorithms; users’ testimonies; and geostatistical
methods.

[Hydrousa (H2020)]

### Hydrousa (H2020)

Demonstration of water loops with innovative regenerative business models for the Mediterranean
region
This project aims to revolutionise water value chains in Mediterranean areas and beyond, by
providing innovative nature-based water management solutions, which will close water loops and boost
the agricultural and energy profile of these areas. AGENSO is responsible for the development of:
* an online monitoring and controlling platform for water loops
* an automated system for optimizing irrigation at agricultural sites based on open source
  technologies
* a serious game for disseminating the project results
[OPTIMA (H2020)]

### OPTIMA (H2020)

Optimised Pest Integrated Management to precisely detect and control plant diseases in perennial
crops and open-field vegetables
OPTIMA will develop an environmentally friendly IPM framework for vineyards, apple orchards and
carrots by providing a holistic integrated approach which includes all critical aspects related to
integrated disease management, such as:
* novel bio-PPPs use
* disease prediction models
* spectral early disease detection systems
* precision spraying techniques
AGENSO is responsible for the development of an innovative DSS with optimized disease prediction
models, using agro-climatic and biological algorithms; users’ testimonies; and geostatistical
methods.

# Pre-Digested Means Fast Acting

Traditional organic fertilizers are simply blends of organic nutrients. When applied to soil, the
plants rely on soil microbes to break down those nutrients to a simple form that the plants can
eventually absorb.

This digestion process usually takes anywhere from weeks to months to take place in soil, which can
make growing organically quite a challenge as it takes a long time for farmers to see results from
these organic inputs.

AgroThrive is the only organic fertilizer that has already gone through this digestion process
before going into the soil, which is what makes our fertilizers the fastest acting organic products
in the market!

In addition, the microbes that finish our digestion are present in the final product to stimulate
soil and contribute to overall plant and soil health.

# Pre-Digested Means Fast Acting

Traditional organic fertilizers are simply blends of organic nutrients. When applied to soil, the
plants rely on soil microbes to break down those nutrients to a simple form that the plants can
eventually absorb.

This digestion process usually takes anywhere from weeks to months to take place in soil, which can
make growing organically quite a challenge as it takes a long time for farmers to see results from
these organic inputs.

AgroThrive is the only organic fertilizer that has already gone through this digestion process
before going into the soil, which is what makes our fertilizers the fastest acting organic products
in the market!

In addition, the microbes that finish our digestion are present in the final product to stimulate
soil and contribute to overall plant and soil health.

# About us

**BAC’s is a story of two entrepreneurs with a passion for organic crop cultivation. Together, they
developed an extensive range of plant feed, stimulants, invigorators and fertilisers for organic and
other forms of crop cultivation. For over 15 years now, BAC’s products have enabled farmers all over
the world to grow healthy plants and an extensive crop.**

### From cultivating roses to developing plant products

It all started with roses. Originally a flower cultivator, Frits Visser is an expert in all things
agrarian. Working organically, he developed extensive knowledge of soil life and micro-organisms,
which he now shares as a consultant to farming and horticultural sectors worldwide –especially in
India and South-America.

In 2003, he joined forces with Theo, who had already developed a number of growth and bloom
stimulants. Their joint expertise has led to a full range of plant products that share one common
goal: the production of healthy plants that grow ample, high quality crops.

### Award winning products

Over the years, multiple organisations have provided great accolade and recognition to our products,
including British [Soil Association][82], Dutch [Skal Bio Controle][83], French Ecocert Group,
German [FIBL][84] and the [Peterson Control Union][85], that works worldwide.

You can read all about our products by clicking on below links:
* [Organic products][86]
* [Mineral products][87]
* [Plant stimulants][88]

# About us

**BAC’s is a story of two entrepreneurs with a passion for organic crop cultivation. Together, they
developed an extensive range of plant feed, stimulants, invigorators and fertilisers for organic and
other forms of crop cultivation. For over 15 years now, BAC’s products have enabled farmers all over
the world to grow healthy plants and an extensive crop.**

### From cultivating roses to developing plant products

It all started with roses. Originally a flower cultivator, Frits Visser is an expert in all things
agrarian. Working organically, he developed extensive knowledge of soil life and micro-organisms,
which he now shares as a consultant to farming and horticultural sectors worldwide –especially in
India and South-America.

In 2003, he joined forces with Theo, who had already developed a number of growth and bloom
stimulants. Their joint expertise has led to a full range of plant products that share one common
goal: the production of healthy plants that grow ample, high quality crops.

### Award winning products

Over the years, multiple organisations have provided great accolade and recognition to our products,
including British [Soil Association][82], Dutch [Skal Bio Controle][83], French Ecocert Group,
German [FIBL][84] and the [Peterson Control Union][85], that works worldwide.

You can read all about our products by clicking on below links:
* [Organic products][86]
* [Mineral products][87]
* [Plant stimulants][88]

# Farmers’ Best Mate

### Fertiliser Manufacturer

## ABOUT US

Cropmate Berhad was incorporated in Malaysia on 11 September 2023 as a public limited company. Our
Company is an investment holding company. Our subsidiary, Cropmate Fertilizer is primarily involved
in the formulation and blending of conventional and specialty fertilisers as well as trading of
straight fertilisers and related products. Cropmate Fertilizer was established in 2018 specialising
as a fertiliser manufacturer and trading of straight fertilisers. While our brand is relatively new
in the market, the founders and staff in Cropmate Fertilizer has over decades of experience and
expertise in fertilisers production and sales.

Cropmate Fertilizer is primarily involved in the formulation and blending of compacted, blended and
specialty fertilisers, as well as the trading of straight fertilisers. We carry out research and
development for new or enhanced formulations of our fertilisers and customised formulations for some
of our customers, aiming to help farmers increase both their yield and product quality. With a team
of experienced directors and management, backed by Mr. Lee Chin Yok’s experience in the fertiliser
industry of over 40 years, Cropmate is off to a strong start with the right team.

believe you shouldn’t have to choose between what’s good for your plants and what’s good for the

[espoma story]

Espoma has been a trusted tradition for generations, with more than nine decades of proven results
that have earned its place among the best-selling organic fertilizers of all time.

Since 1929, our natural plant foods and soils have been refined with passion, dedication, and
innovation to create products that are classic, timeless, and environmentally friendly. If you’re an
Espoma Organic gardener, you’re in good company—chances are your mom, aunt, or grandfather was too.

#### Family-Owned Since 1929

Espoma has remained proudly family-owned for five generations, preserving a legacy of quality and
care in every product we make.

#### Environment First

We put the planet first—designing our processes and products to protect soil health, reduce waste,
and support biodiversity.

#### Organic is in Our DNA

From the beginning, Espoma has championed organic gardening – because healthy gardens start with
natural ingredients you can trust.

#### Partners With You

Whether you’re a backyard hobbyist or a seasoned grower, we’re with you every step of the way –
sharing knowledge, tools, and support.

#### Committed to Sustainability

Sustainability isn’t a trend for us, it’s a core value. Our packaging, practices, and products are
built to nurture your garden and the earth.

#### State-of-the-Art Facility

Our solar-powered, cutting-edge facility ensures precision, quality, and minimal environmental
impact in every product we produce.

### FERTİKİM

## TARIM KİMYA SANAYİ VE TİCARET A.Ş.

Adı güvenilirlik, verimlilik, fayda ve kaliteyle özdeşleşmiş bir firma olan Fertikim, genel olarak
bitki besleme ürünlerinin üretimi ve pazarlanması amacı ile Levent Alku tarafından 1998 yılında
İzmir'de kurulmuştur. Üstün kaliteli ve çözüm odaklı ürün & hizmet anlayışı ile kendisini kabul
ettiren şirket çok kısa bir sürede sektöründe önemli bir aşama kaydetmiş, geniş ve kaliteli bir ürün
yelpazesine ulaşmıştır. Sahip olduğu markalar ve pazar gücünün yanı sıra faaliyet gösterdiği her
alanda mükemmelliği hedefleyen yaklaşımı ve savunduğu etik değerlerle tarım alanında saygın bir yere
sahiptir. Kuruluşundan itibaren bitki besleme alanında kendi markası ve tescilleri ile üretim yapıp
pazarlayabildiği gibi, hem yerli firmalara hem de uluslararası firmalara fason üretim
yapabilmektedir.

## Yönetim Kurulu Başkanımız Diyor Ki

> İş yaşamıma 1984 yılında uluslararası bir firmada zirai ilaç sektöründe başladım.1986 yılından
> itibaren gübre sektörüne geçtim ve bir holding şirketinde 11 yıl boyunca mineral gübre işinde
> satış ve pazarlama yöneticiliği yaptım. 1986 yılı benim açımdan da ülkemiz mineral gübre sektörü
> açısından da çok önemli bir yıldır. Mineral gübreler artık devlet kurumları yerine bayilik sistemi
> tarafından çiftçilere satılacaktı ve bu değişiklik bana sistemi kuranlardan birisi olabilme ortamı
> sağlayacaktı. Çok Şanslıydım!.. Bu arada dünyadaki gübre kullanımı hızla artmakta, gübreler
> çeşitlenmekte, daha önceleri sadece topraktan yapılan uygulama şekilleri hızla değişmekte ve buna
> bağlı olarak açık saha ve sera ortamlarında kullanılan gübre tipleri gelişmekte ve bunun da verim
> artışına olan yansıması net olarak izlenmekteydi. İşte tam da bu dönemde özel gübreler üretme
> kararı ile Fertikim Tarım Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş.’ini kurdum. 26 yılı doldurmakta olan
> şirketimizde birçok yeni ürün ve ürün grubuna imza attık. Bu dönem içerisinde sektördeki
> gelişmeleri takip ederek çiftçilerin verim artışına destek olacak, ve birim maliyetlerini aşağıya
> çekecek, ama bu arada kaliteden ödün vermeyecek bir politika izledik. Beş tane tescilli marka ve
> 100’den fazla ürün geliştirdik. Son kullanıcımız olan çiftçilerden her zaman olumlu geri dönüşler
> aldık. Artık ülkemizde ve çalıştığımız yurt dışı pazarlarda KALİTE, GÜVEN, FAYDA sloganını
> benimseyen ve bundan asla taviz vermeyen yapısıyla önemli bir şirkete dönüşmüş olduk. Ekibimizden
> üretim hattımızdan çıkan ürüne, müşterilerimize, hatta ürünlerimizi kullanan çiftçilere kadar
> nasıl bir sorumluluk taşıdığımızın farkında olarak, işimizi çok severek her gün geliştirmek ve

### FERTİKİM

## TARIM KİMYA SANAYİ VE TİCARET A.Ş.

Adı güvenilirlik, verimlilik, fayda ve kaliteyle özdeşleşmiş bir firma olan Fertikim, genel olarak
bitki besleme ürünlerinin üretimi ve pazarlanması amacı ile Levent Alku tarafından 1998 yılında
İzmir'de kurulmuştur. Üstün kaliteli ve çözüm odaklı ürün & hizmet anlayışı ile kendisini kabul
ettiren şirket çok kısa bir sürede sektöründe önemli bir aşama kaydetmiş, geniş ve kaliteli bir ürün
yelpazesine ulaşmıştır. Sahip olduğu markalar ve pazar gücünün yanı sıra faaliyet gösterdiği her
alanda mükemmelliği hedefleyen yaklaşımı ve savunduğu etik değerlerle tarım alanında saygın bir yere
sahiptir. Kuruluşundan itibaren bitki besleme alanında kendi markası ve tescilleri ile üretim yapıp
pazarlayabildiği gibi, hem yerli firmalara hem de uluslararası firmalara fason üretim
yapabilmektedir.

## Ürün Gruplarımız

Fertikim olarak kaliteli ve sürdürülebilir tarım yapmayı hedeflemiş çiftçilere en iyi hizmet ve
imkanı sunmak için teknolojiyi takip ederek çalışmalarımızı sürdürmekteyiz.

## Yönetim Kurulu Başkanımız Diyor Ki

> İş yaşamıma 1984 yılında uluslararası bir firmada zirai ilaç sektöründe başladım.1986 yılından
> itibaren gübre sektörüne geçtim ve bir holding şirketinde 11 yıl boyunca mineral gübre işinde
> satış ve pazarlama yöneticiliği yaptım. 1986 yılı benim açımdan da ülkemiz mineral gübre sektörü
> açısından da çok önemli bir yıldır. Mineral gübreler artık devlet kurumları yerine bayilik sistemi
> tarafından çiftçilere satılacaktı ve bu değişiklik bana sistemi kuranlardan birisi olabilme ortamı
> sağlayacaktı. Çok Şanslıydım!.. Bu arada dünyadaki gübre kullanımı hızla artmakta, gübreler
> çeşitlenmekte, daha önceleri sadece topraktan yapılan uygulama şekilleri hızla değişmekte ve buna
> bağlı olarak açık saha ve sera ortamlarında kullanılan gübre tipleri gelişmekte ve bunun da verim
> artışına olan yansıması net olarak izlenmekteydi. İşte tam da bu dönemde özel gübreler üretme
> kararı ile Fertikim Tarım Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş.’ini kurdum. 26 yılı doldurmakta olan
> şirketimizde birçok yeni ürün ve ürün grubuna imza attık. Bu dönem içerisinde sektördeki
> gelişmeleri takip ederek çiftçilerin verim artışına destek olacak, ve birim maliyetlerini aşağıya
> çekecek, ama bu arada kaliteden ödün vermeyecek bir politika izledik. Beş tane tescilli marka ve
> 100’den fazla ürün geliştirdik. Son kullanıcımız olan çiftçilerden her zaman olumlu geri dönüşler
> aldık. Artık ülkemizde ve çalıştığımız yurt dışı pazarlarda KALİTE, GÜVEN, FAYDA sloganını
> benimseyen ve bundan asla taviz vermeyen yapısıyla önemli bir şirkete dönüşmüş olduk. Ekibimizden
> üretim hattımızdan çıkan ürüne, müşterilerimize, hatta ürünlerimizi kullanan çiftçilere kadar
> nasıl bir sorumluluk taşıdığımızın farkında olarak, işimizi çok severek her gün geliştirmek ve
> daha üst seviyelere çıkarabilmek için var gücümüzle çalışmaya devam edeceğiz.

> açısından da çok önemli bir yıldır. Mineral gübreler artık devlet kurumları yerine bayilik sistemi
> tarafından çiftçilere satılacaktı ve bu değişiklik bana sistemi kuranlardan birisi olabilme ortamı
> sağlayacaktı. Çok Şanslıydım!.. Bu arada dünyadaki gübre kullanımı hızla artmakta, gübreler
> çeşitlenmekte, daha önceleri sadece topraktan yapılan uygulama şekilleri hızla değişmekte ve buna
> bağlı olarak açık saha ve sera ortamlarında kullanılan gübre tipleri gelişmekte ve bunun da verim
> artışına olan yansıması net olarak izlenmekteydi. İşte tam da bu dönemde özel gübreler üretme
> kararı ile Fertikim Tarım Kimya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş.’ini kurdum. 26 yılı doldurmakta olan
> şirketimizde birçok yeni ürün ve ürün grubuna imza attık. Bu dönem içerisinde sektördeki
> gelişmeleri takip ederek çiftçilerin verim artışına destek olacak, ve birim maliyetlerini aşağıya
> çekecek, ama bu arada kaliteden ödün vermeyecek bir politika izledik. Beş tane tescilli marka ve
> 100’den fazla ürün geliştirdik. Son kullanıcımız olan çiftçilerden her zaman olumlu geri dönüşler
> aldık. Artık ülkemizde ve çalıştığımız yurt dışı pazarlarda KALİTE, GÜVEN, FAYDA sloganını
> benimseyen ve bundan asla taviz vermeyen yapısıyla önemli bir şirkete dönüşmüş olduk. Ekibimizden
> üretim hattımızdan çıkan ürüne, müşterilerimize, hatta ürünlerimizi kullanan çiftçilere kadar
> nasıl bir sorumluluk taşıdığımızın farkında olarak, işimizi çok severek her gün geliştirmek ve
> daha üst seviyelere çıkarabilmek için var gücümüzle çalışmaya devam edeceğiz.

Ferti-Organic was founded in 2010 to meet the growing demand for natural agricultural inputs for
organic farming. Since then, we have built a strong reputation based on product quality, competitive
pricing, and a commitment to exceptional service.

Our products include materials approved by the California Department of Food and Agriculture and
listed by Organic Materials Review Institute, making them suitable for use in certified organic
operations under the United States Department of Agriculture organic program.

Ferti-Organic is part of MYCSA GROUP, a global organization founded in 2004 by Federico and María
Cristina Casillas. As the group expanded — including major infrastructure developments in 2012 and
2016 — the company established an international presence.

Today, María Cristina Casillas continues to lead the organization, driving the vision that has
positioned the group as a global reference in organic agricultural solutions.

to an imbalance in the "cation exchange". If cations are out of balance, anions will also not work

### Industry Field

As a professional electronic components distributor, FTC supports industries worldwide in addressing
challenges like shortages and the growing demand for obsolete electronic components.

Our reliable distribution of electronic components helps drive innovation across sectors. Whether in
Automotive & EV, Automation, or Artificial Intelligence, essential electronics components — from
semiconductors to capacitors — are fundamental to progress.

We are not just an electronic part supplier; we also partner with electronics components
distributors and wholesalers. Our presence extends globally, with support for customers in the USA,
Singapore, and other regions. This makes FTC a trusted electronics components distributor in USA and
a reliable partner for electronic components Singapore.

Looking forward, we will strengthen our role as a premier electronics components distributor,
enhancing services for the evolving needs of global industries.

# Discover organic growing

Garden Organic promotes organic growing and composting, citizen science and research, and seed
conservation through our Heritage Seed Library. We want to help you garden 'the organic way', using
natural methods to promote healthy, productive, sustainable gardens.

[Alternative text should describe the visual content of the image.]

## Sign our petition

Help us get the dangerous herbicide glyphosate out of our gardens, parks, playgrounds and public
spaces.

[ sign our petition ][99]

## Get into organic
1. [
   [Flowers and vegetables growing together]
   
   ### Donate to Garden Organic
   
   By making a gift, however large or small, you will contribute to our vital work. You can support
   our charitable activities with a regular or one-off donation.
   
   ][100]
2. [
   [Alternative text should describe the visual content of the image.]
   
   ### Join us
   
   By becoming a member you can join the thousands of people in the UK and overseas who are already
   leading the movement for an organic and sustainable future for us all.
   
   ][101]
3. [
   [Alternative text should describe the visual content of the image.]
   
   ### The Heritage Seed Library
   
   The Heritage Seed Library (HSL) maintains the national collection of heritage vegetables and aims
   to conserve vegetable varieties that are not widely available, sharing seed with our members to
   grow and enjoy.
   
   ][102]

[Enrol on our Online Certificate with Chris Collins]

Our Introduction to Organic Growing online certificate has been carefully designed for both early
career gardeners and amateur growers keen to expand their skills in organic growing.

[ Find out more and enrol today! ][103]

# Mission &
# Philosophy.

Restoring soil is more than agriculture. It is the foundation of resilient ecosystems, thriving
civilizations, and generational prosperity.

Discover
Core Doctrine

## Core Philosophical Pillars

The fundamental truths that govern our approach to global agriculture.

01

### Soil Sovereignty

Control over soil health restores ecological independence and long-term resilience.

"Healthy soil is the ultimate form of sovereignty — it anchors food systems, water cycles, and
biodiversity."

02

### Civilizational Capacity

Sustainable agriculture forms the backbone of strong societies.

"Every great civilization rose and fell on the health of its land. We rebuild the foundation."

03

### Biological Intelligence

Nature's complex biological systems guide regenerative design.

"From mycorrhizal networks to microbial consortia, we decode nature's operating system."

04

### Future Heritage Assets

Healthy soil compounds value across generations.

"Restored farmland is the most durable store of value humanity can create."

The Transformation

## From Degraded Land
## to Living Ecosystems.

Phase 01 · Diagnosis

### Condition Zero

Understanding degraded ecosystems and soil collapse.

We begin with comprehensive soil profiling — mapping compaction layers, microbial deserts, and
chemical saturation.

Phase 02 · Catalysis

### Biological Intervention

Introducing microbial and fungal life to restart soil processes.

Targeted inoculants are introduced to catalyse decomposition pathways and restart the nutrient
cycle.

Phase 03 · Emergence

### Living Soil

Building a complex self-sustaining soil ecosystem.

As biodiversity compounds, the soil begins to self-regulate — retaining moisture and suppressing
pathogens.

Phase 04 · Abundance

### Productive Farms

Transforming regenerated soil into resilient food systems.

With biology restored, farms achieve yields that rival conventional systems while building legacy
land value.

The Architecture

## System Logic

Regenerative systems mirror nature's intelligence. Mycelial networks and carbon cycles form the
architecture of resilience.

⬡

### Mycelial Architecture

Designing infrastructure inspired by fungal communication networks and distributed intelligence.

◎

### Carbon Sequestration

Transforming atmospheric carbon into stable soil structures that persist for generations.

〜

### Water Cycle Restoration

## High Availability Phosphorus

## Increased yields can sometimes be difficult to track with MAP/DAP as it’s hard to ensure plants

## That’s because most phosphorus fertilizers take considerable time to be broken down for crops to

## gone through both an anaerobic and aerobic process, our nutrients have been broken down so they
## are more readily available for your crops to uptake when needed most.

# High Functioning Biologicals

HUMANE-FX3 has scored one of the highest functionality ratings in the industry for our biologicals.
This is important as biologicals supply approximately 75% of the plant-available nitrogen and 65% of
the available phosphorus in the soil.

 

Our beneficial bacteria and fungi solubilize nutrients, enhancing your crops’ nutrient uptake. They
improve soil health and structure by promoting beneficial microorganism growth and increasing
organic matter.

 

Additionally, HUMANE-FX3’s biologicals reduce plant diseases, and help plants tolerate environmental
stresses like drought and salinity by enhancing natural defense mechanisms. This ultimately
increases crop yield and quality.

## Renewable Resource

The Power of Upcylcing 

HUMANE promotes a closed-loop system where waste products are repurposed rather than becoming
environmental pollutants. FX3 utilizes a pig manure as its base to help close that loop. It is rich
in essential nutrients such as nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, which are necessary for plant
growth. By using hog manure as fertilizer, these nutrients are recycled back into the soil,
enriching it naturally and reducing the need for synthetic fertilizers while increasing organic
matter, biological activity, and carbon sequestration.

## ABOUT US

International Network for Natural Sciences (INNSpub) is an open access Research Journal Publisher
that's dedicated to Publish Scholarly Research papers, Project paper and Books, to believe in
sharing new scientific knowledge in the field of Biological sciences, Environmental sciences,
Agricultural sciences, Biotechnology, Social science, Genetices, Biodiversity and Herbal medicine
all over the World and aims to provide a platform for Students, Researchers and Scholars to publish
their research work and make it accessible to the wider Scientific community. All INNSpub
publications are available on digital platforms that concurrently belong to many Societies,
Libraries, Indexing database, Universities and Research Institutes of the World.

## Unique Features
* Fast-track peer-reviewed by international experts
* Continuous and Fast nature publications
* Open access for facilitating with a higher number of citations
* Covered by renowned abstracting and indexing services
* All IJB articles are assigned to CrossRef DOI number

submission. Manuscripts should be submitted to the Editor of the [desired journal][98] via the

submitting a new manuscript.

Write a manuscript according to the [author guidelines][96], download the [paper template][97] and

### Do I have to format my paper according desire journal style for review ?

Yes, INNSpub requires all articles to follow its [specific format][100] for submission, review and

submitting a new manuscript.

### How do I submit my manuscript to INNSPUB Journals ?

After completing the paper writing, finally check the paper format before submission. Authors are
encouraged to submit their manuscripts electronically by the ‘[Journal Managerial Panel][102] or via
email attachment.

Yes, a scanned copy of the filled copyright agreement form is mandatory with paper submission. The
author must have submitted a ‘[Copyright agreement][103]‘ form during the article submission to the
Editor.

### When I will get the acceptance letter, if my paper is accepted ?

The acceptance letter is provided just after the confirmation of receiving the publication fee from
the author(s). It takes maximum 24-48 hours after getting publication fees.

### We have submitted our paper by using email and did not get tracking number ?

For email, submission author can get their manuscript tracking number after 24 hours of paper
submission.

### How many days are required for review process to complete ?

The total time required for the peer review process is approximately 2 to 5 days depending on the
manuscript, reviewers’ availability & terms.

## Our Story

Our story as Living Soil began in 1992, but our roots run much deeper. As a generationally owned
family farm, we are focused on sharing our experience and knowledge with biologicals and organic
fertilizer with farmers around the Midwest for the betterment of their farm and land. Our goal is to
help conventional farmers make more of their land by switching to a regenerative, biological, or
organic program that fits the needs of their farm. We distribute top-of-the-line fertilizer products
from several trusted companies across the United States.

## ABOUT US

**Mahadhan Agritech Limited (MAL)** formerly known as **Smartchem Technologies Limited (STL)** is a
100% subsidiary of Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals Corporation Limited, a publicly listed,
multi-product Indian conglomerate with an annual turnover of over a billion USD and a multi-product
portfolio spanning across industrial chemicals, bulk and specialty fertilisers, farming diagnostics
and solutions.

[READ MORE][27]

## Crop Nutrition Products

The company is one of India’s leading manufacturers of NPK and specialty fertilizers. Under its
flagship brand Mahadhan, it produces high quality NPK, specialty, and water soluble fertilizers. The
brand offers a comprehensive portfolio of 48 products, including bulk fertilizers, specialty
fertilizers, water soluble fertilizers, micronutrients, and secondary nutrients—catering to the
complete crop nutrition needs of farmers.

Mahadhan, a brand synonymous with quality and trust, has been serving the farming community for over
30 years, consistently delivering high quality products that help farmers enhance both yield and
produce quality. Headquartered in Maharashtra, the company is strategically positioned to serve key
horticulture and cash crop regions across India. The state-of-the-art technologies deployed by the
company has a provision of manufacturing multiple grades with an option of customizing the products
to suit specific crop and farmer requirements.

[READ MORE][28]

### Market leader for specialty products, water solubles, specialty fertilisers and Bentonite
### Sulphur

### ISO 17025 accredited laboratory for agri-research

### Manufacturing facility at Taloja installed with the latest INCRO technology

**Enjoying our Sustainable Lifestyle and an Alternative (Energy) Philosophy**                       
*with Good Cheer!  Sue Robishaw & Steve Schmeck***                                                  
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
**Welcome!  ...**                                                                                   
                                                                                                    
Playing music, carving wood, dancing, gardening, building, writing -- we do what we enjoy, and enjoy
what we do. Life is so full and we appreciate all it gives us, opportunities and challenges alike.  
We are never bored, often happy -- learning, loving, living, laughing. Do we have downs as well as  
ups? Of course! How boring it would be if it were not so. But the dips help us decide what it is we 
want, and what we want changes as we continue to grow. We are now in our 70's and looking forward to
where we will be next year, and the year after, and the next ... But it is this moment we relish    
most and we're happy to share some of our moments with you. We are as drawn to the artwork of the   
spider and the incredible beauty of fresh fallen snow in the trees as we are with the technology    
that allows us to connect with so many of[Sue and Steve hiking] you. What a fascinating world we    
live as part of.                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
We welcome you into our lives via our website. May you have a good time while here, and leave with  
inspiration and a smile.

# **Welcome to Mary’s Alpaca Poop+**

## Premium Organic Fertilizer for Cannabis & More

#### Unlike other organic fertilizers, **alpaca manure is low in nitrogen salts**, which means it
#### **won’t burn your plant roots**.

#### Alpacas also have a highly efficient digestive system and a clean diet—no antibiotics or
#### GMOs—so their waste is rich, balanced, and free from harmful additives.

#### It’s one of the cleanest, safest, and most effective manures you can use for **cannabis
#### cultivation**, **indoor plants**, and **sustainable gardening**.

[ Click to Compare Mary's Poop+ To Other Organic Fertilizer Brands ][53]

# Why Choose Alpaca Poop?

## **The best fertilizer - in a Pod!**

We’ve taken nature’s best fertilizer and made it even easier to use. Just drop a Poop+Pod into a
gallon of water, let it dissolve, stir, and water as usual. Our **biodegradable pods** are made from
**PVA (polyvinyl alcohol)** - a water-soluble material that’s safe for the environment and leaves no
waste behind.

### **Perfect for Growers of All Kinds**

Whether you're a home gardener, professional grower, or running a small farm, Mary’s Alpaca Poop+
delivers reliable results for:
* **Cannabis cultivation (indoor and outdoor)**
* **Houseplants, succulents, and tropicals**
* **Vegetables, herbs, and edible gardens**
* **Nurseries, garden centers, and horticulturists**

## Why Mary’s Poop?

#### **100% Organic & Sustainable**

#### Made from pesticide-free, antibiotic-free alpacas raised on our clean Virginia pastures. Did
#### you know it takes an alpaca up to 62 hours to digest what they eat? That long, efficient
#### digestive process fully breaks down organic material, leaving zero odor in the poop. Their
#### gentle diet of grasses, hay, and natural minerals makes alpaca manure one of the cleanest, most
#### nutrient-rich fertilizers available.

#### **Proven Growth Boost**

#### Scientifically backed ingredients that enhance seedling growth, flower density, and cannabinoid
#### profiles.

#### **Low Odor, High Benefit**

#### Thanks to the alpaca’s unique digestive system, there’s zero odor in the manure—seriously!

#### **Safe for Soil & Hydroponics**

Works beautifully in soil, raised beds, containers, and even hydro setups.

Nuestra Historia

MYCSA AG abrió sus puertas en 2004, transformando el concepto de insumos agrícolas mediante materias
primas orgánicas y repelentes naturales que permiten a los agricultores certificar sus cultivos como
orgánicos y contribuir a una huella ecológica positiva.

Nuestra historia nace de la visión de Federico y María Cristina Casillas, quienes fundaron Fertichem

expansión internacional del grupo.

MYCSA AG es parte de MYCSA Group un proveedor establecido en Brownsville, TX, líder a nivel global
en el mercado de insumos orgánicos, materias primas, soluciones y otros productos para la industria

Durante años hemos contado con materiales listados y aprobados por OMRI.

Formuladores y agricultores de todo el mundo prefieren nuestros productos por su calidad, precios
competitivos, excelente servicio y el compromiso ambiental que compartimos.

Podemos enviar nuestros productos de manera rápida y directa a cualquier parte del mundo con la
confianza que nuestros clientes lo recibirán en óptimas condiciones.

Nuestra Historia

MYCSA AG abrió sus puertas en 2004, transformando el concepto de insumos agrícolas mediante materias
primas orgánicas y repelentes naturales que permiten a los agricultores certificar sus cultivos como
orgánicos y contribuir a una huella ecológica positiva.

Nuestra historia nace de la visión de Federico y María Cristina Casillas, quienes fundaron Fertichem
en la Ciudad de México. En 2008, MYCSA AG se establece en Brownsville, Texas, dando inicio a la
expansión internacional del grupo.

Hoy, MYCSA AG forma parte de MYCSA GROUP, un grupo global con presencia en distintos países. María
Cristina Casillas continúa liderando la organización, manteniendo vivo el legado de innovación,
sostenibilidad y crecimiento.

## Nurturing Soil.

## Nourishing Nations.



Guided by the powerful motto **“Save the Soil, Save the Nation,”** Nature Care Fertilizers Pvt.
Ltd., based in Vita, is a leading force in sustainable agriculture. Since 1997, we have offered
farmers a reliable and effective alternative to chemical-based farming through our range of
certified organic fertilizers.

Founded by Mr. **Jayant Vaman Barve**—fondly known as **Baba Barve**—the company is built on over
four decades of dedication to organic farming. A scientist turned farmer, Mr. Barve has spent years
researching and advocating for poison-free food systems, even when it meant challenging the
conventional norms of modern agriculture.



At a time when excessive chemical use was degrading soil health across India, he introduced **Green
Harvest**—a uniquely formulated, compost-free organic fertilizer designed to restore fertility and
eliminate the need for synthetic inputs.

Today, Nature Care Fertilizers is an **ISO 9001:2015 certified** manufacturer, trusted by farmers
across Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh, and international markets including
Kenya, Tanzania, Angola, and Mauritius.



Our product line—featuring [Green Harvest,][83][ **Green Harvest Special**][84], [**Green Harvest
Granules**][85], along with **bio-fertilizers** and **polyphosphate fertilizers**—caters to the
needs of modern agriculture while preserving ecological balance.

Every product is certified by agricultural departments of Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Goa, and
internationally by **Ecocert** under **USDA NOP**, **EU**, and **NPOP** organic standards. Our
formulations have been rigorously tested by leading agricultural institutions such as **Rahuri

## Nourishing Nations.



Guided by the powerful motto **“Save the Soil, Save the Nation,”** Nature Care Fertilizers Pvt.

farmers a reliable and effective alternative to chemical-based farming through our range of
certified organic fertilizers.

Founded by Mr. **Jayant Vaman Barve**—fondly known as **Baba Barve**—the company is built on over
four decades of dedication to organic farming. A scientist turned farmer, Mr. Barve has spent years
researching and advocating for poison-free food systems, even when it meant challenging the
conventional norms of modern agriculture.



At a time when excessive chemical use was degrading soil health across India, he introduced **Green
Harvest**—a uniquely formulated, compost-free organic fertilizer designed to restore fertility and
eliminate the need for synthetic inputs.

Today, Nature Care Fertilizers is an **ISO 9001:2015 certified** manufacturer, trusted by farmers
across Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh, and international markets including
Kenya, Tanzania, Angola, and Mauritius.



Our product line—featuring [Green Harvest,][83][ **Green Harvest Special**][84], [**Green Harvest
Granules**][85], along with **bio-fertilizers** and **polyphosphate fertilizers**—caters to the

# Plant-Based Organic Fertilizer
# —

### OUR PROCESS

## We make plant-based, organic fertilizer. For the good of our farmers and the planet.

### **Nitricity uses air, water, clean energy, and almond shells to brew an organic fertilizer.**

### —
### Fertilizers are responsible for 5% of global greenhouse gas emissions.

Manufacturing conventional fertilizer requires enormous energy, mostly from power plants that burn
fossil fuels and release greenhouse gasses.

### —
### Sustainable alternatives exist, but can be costly.

Sustainably made fertilizers are essential for organic agriculture. They offer benefits for the soil
and consumer health. Yet, existing sustainable fertilizers are restricted by high costs, nutrient
reliability, and operational challenges.

[ Learn more ][33]

## There is a critical need for sustainable organic fertilizer that efficiently delivers nutrients.

#### Nitricity answers this need. Our fertilier is:
* #### Plant-based
  
  Free of animal inputs, pathogens, and odors
* #### High efficiency
  
  Reliably provides essential nutrients
* #### Irrigable, non-clogging
  
  Filtered for modern irrigation systems
* #### Clean Energy
  
   Made with clean power sources
* #### Seasonal flexibility
  
  Ideal for midseason applications

# Plant-Based Organic Fertilizer
# —

### OUR PROCESS

## We make plant-based, organic fertilizer. For the good of our farmers and the planet.

### **Nitricity uses air, water, clean energy, and almond shells to brew an organic fertilizer.**

### —
### Fertilizers are responsible for 5% of global greenhouse gas emissions.

Manufacturing conventional fertilizer requires enormous energy, mostly from power plants that burn
fossil fuels and release greenhouse gasses.

### —
### Sustainable alternatives exist, but can be costly.

Sustainably made fertilizers are essential for organic agriculture. They offer benefits for the soil
and consumer health. Yet, existing sustainable fertilizers are restricted by high costs, nutrient
reliability, and operational challenges.

[ Learn more ][33]

## There is a critical need for sustainable organic fertilizer that efficiently delivers nutrients.

#### Nitricity answers this need. Our fertilier is:
* #### Plant-based
  
  Free of animal inputs, pathogens, and odors
* #### High efficiency
  
  Reliably provides essential nutrients
* #### Irrigable, non-clogging
  
  Filtered for modern irrigation systems
* #### Clean Energy
  
   Made with clean power sources
* #### Seasonal flexibility
  
  Ideal for midseason applications

## Natural Ammonia Platform

## Patented Biological Nitrogen. Commercial Scale Production.

California Organic Fertilizers has developed and commercialized a patented biological nitrogen
conversion platform producing plant-available ammoniacal nitrogen under U.S. Patent No. 11,518,720.


Operating in a nitrogen-dominant biological regime, Natural Ammonia™ products are integrated into
our 35+ year fertilizer distribution network and now available at commercial scale.

[Learn About Natural Ammonia ][20][Request Product Information ][21]

## 4-1-1

An expertly balanced fertilizer, specifically formulated to promote steady, healthy growth and
vibrant, robust blooms-without excessive foliage. Phytamin® Jumpstart 4-1-1 provides a biologically

ammonia into a very clean clear aqueous solution.

It is a well-known fact that chemical fertilizers’ efficiencies are very low due to leaching,
volatilisation and fixation. This contributes to low fertilizer efficiency (as low as 40-60% for
nitrogen, 40-50% for potassium, and 30% for phosphorous). The most limiting factor today is
microbial activity in the soil. Plant nutritionists must integrate plant nutrition and soil biology.
Research has consistently shown that soil micro-organisms will increase the efficiency of applied
fertilizers.

## From Nature to Nurture: The Organic Fertilizer Journey

Join us as we take you behind the scenes at Organic Fertilizer Manufacturers Botswana. Discover the
eco-friendly process of transforming natural materials into nutrient-rich organic fertilizer that
helps your crops thrive. From sourcing sustainable ingredients to producing high-quality
fertilizers, we’re committed to supporting healthier soils and greener farming practices. 🌱


Want to see how we make it happen? Watch now and learn how we’re growing Botswana’s agricultural
future—one bag at a time!

"A nation that destroys its soil, destroys itself" - Franklin D. Roosevelt


For every 1% increase in soil organic matter per hectare:

22-29 Kg of Nitrogen is available every year

5-7 Kg of Phosphate is available every year

2-3 Kg of Sulphur is available every year

234,000 Litres of available water


## A Consensus has emerged that the highest and most sustainable gains in crop production are
## achieved from the integration of Organic and Chemical Fertilizer components.

  crops.

# How To Grow Your Own Organic, Nutrient-Dense Food

To be optimally healthy, we need nutritious food, which can be hard to find anymore.

Even organic farmers have a tough time growing food that’s as nutritionally-dense as what you can
grow in your backyard or your balcony.

But growing organic food comes with challenges: insects destroy your plants, weeds take over, fruits
and veggies just don’t go anywhere.

And all of that before we get to nutrition side of things.

But I’m here to help with all of that. I’ll give you a few things to check out down below…

[Garden Organic]

## FREE Food Growing Course

This is my most recent project, 22 lessons (video, text, and images).

We start by preparing the soil, then move to designing the garden, then planting it, and finally
maintaining and harvesting it.

At each step, there are things you can do to increase the nutrition in the food.

And fortunately, doing that also improves flavor, increases storage time for winter, and decreases
insects pests (because insects eat plants that are low in nutrients).

[FREE Food Growing Course ↗][8]
[Garden Bird]

## Choose Your Own Adventure

For more casual learning, you can go to the blog to see all lessons from newest to oldest.

Through a combination of video and text, I’ll show you how to improve soil and plant health using
inoculants, compost, fertilizers, and more.

Some years I post 20 lessons and other years I’m too busy to post anything at all, but the lessons
are evergreen, so feel free to go back through them.

[Organic Gardening Blog][9]
[Garden Book]

## Organic Fertilizers

Many people come here because they want to grow healthier plants.

I’ve learned that the most common 2 goals are to grow:
1. Plants that don’t get bothered by pests, and
2. Plants that produce more nutritious food.

That’s where organic fertilizers and microbial inoculants really make a big difference.

[Organic Fertilizer Guide][10]
[Garden Apple]

## About Me

My name is Phil Nauta. I’m an organic gardener.

I grew up working for my parents in their garden center.

I didn’t think I’d want to keep gardening after so many years of cutting grass and digging holes.

But I fell in love with gardening when I studied the organic approach.

My main area of interest is improving soil and plant health in order to grow organic, nutrient-dense
food.

practices.

# Join us in providing solutions to poverty

People living in poverty face an increasingly stark set of challenges: hunger, climate change,
vulnerable food systems, unequal opportunities for women, and youth unemployment. Now more than
ever, they need your help. Solutions to poverty require urgent action. We’re here to make that as
easy as possible.

The TechnoServe touch

## A different way to make a difference

While giveaways and subsidies may help ease the burden of poverty in the short term, they are
unlikely to make any lasting impact. At TechnoServe, we help people lift themselves out of poverty
through agriculture and [entrepreneurship][72] development programs that apply a distinct mix of
business acumen, deep knowledge of local contexts, and a data-first mindset. This unique approach is
only possible because of people like you.

The people we serve

## Every human deserves a brighter future

TechnoServe is a non-profit organization delivering solutions to poverty. For the last 50 years, we
have helped people in low-income communities around the world build better futures for themselves.
We work directly with enterprising [women][69] and men in developing countries—smallholder farmers,
food processors, and small business owners—to give them the skills, connections, and confidence to
change their lives.  Your support makes it possible for people to build a better future.

[Donate][70]
[Who we serve][71]

The TechnoServe touch

## A different way to make a difference

While giveaways and subsidies may help ease the burden of poverty in the short term, they are
unlikely to make any lasting impact. At TechnoServe, we help people lift themselves out of poverty
through agriculture and [entrepreneurship][72] development programs that apply a distinct mix of
business acumen, deep knowledge of local contexts, and a data-first mindset. This unique approach is
only possible because of people like you.

# The Worldwide Leader
# in Organic Fertilizer

[More Below ][14]

### Family Owned and
### Run Since 2003

True® is the worldwide leader in diverse and innovative production of organic fertilizers. We are a
family-owned business who respectfully treats our growers’ land as if it were our own. We are
passionately dedicated to manufacturing the highest quality, safest and easiest-to-handle organic
fertilizers developed exclusively to help you grow your business.
[Read More][15]

## Take a Tour

[fastcarousel_id id="603"]

## Product Safety

### Our Products are Tested for Quality and Safety

True’s commitment to Product Safety is evident by our full-time on-site food safety staff who
oversee all of our processes and procedures.  With stringent rules for separation, treatment and
testing, all of our outgoing products exceed industry requirements.
[Product Safety][16]

%

### Percentage of OUTGOING fertilizer tested

## Research

Our full-time research and development team are evaluating new inputs and constantly gathering new
data through field, greenhouse and laboratory trials to further our knowledge and allow True to
create only the best organic fertilizers possible, for every crop.
[Learn More][17]

## Products

True**®** takes pride in manufacturing organic fertilizers proven to build and strengthen our
growers’ soil with every application. Our products are designed to function in diverse geographic
and environmental conditions.  Agronomic programs that use our products will improve the soil and
provide the nutrients that will enhance the health of your crops and increase your overall yield.
[View Products][18]

### We Specialize in One Thing

We are passionately dedicated to manufacturing the highest quality, safest and easiest-to-handle
organic fertilizers.

It’s all we do!

[Read More][19]

**At True Organic Products, we believe helping our growers build their business extends beyond what
goes in the ground. We believe in contributing to the overall health and well-being of the
communities we serve through the support of various non-profits and faith-based organizations.**

## **Growing Nature Academy**

[Learn More][53]

**Our movement is growing!**

For over 25 years, the Vegan Organic Network Charity has been supporting farmers, growers and
gardeners on how to grow food in an organic way without using any animal inputs (hence stock-free)
and instead using plant-based fertilisers and kinder methods which respects animals, supports
wildlife and nourishes more people per hectare.

We give grants to farmers to become certified through the Soil Association as Stockfree Organic
farms and provide bursaries and educational resources to veganic gardeners.

Also, we are creating the world’s first map of veganic gardeners and Stockfree Organic farms.

The Vegan Organic Network charity is the only organisation in the UK solely working for food to be
grown the veganic way. Animal agriculture is one of the leading drivers of species extinction, ocean
dead zones, river pollution and soil degradation. Through education, advice and hands on support,
we’re on the way to a cruelty-free future, where everyone can access nourishing food. **Everyone’s
invited.** Will you join us and take action?

#### About us

## What is veganic?

‘Veganic’ is a combination of two words ‘vegan’ and ‘organic’.  **Veganic** also known as
**Stockfree Organic** is a guarantee that food is grown in an organic way with only plant based
fertilisers, encouraging functional biodiversity so pesticides aren’t needed.

No chemicals, no GMO and absolutely no animal by-products in any part of the chain. Animal
by-products such as bone meal, fish blood and animal faeces obtained from captive farmed animals are
still used in farming and we aim to help people switch.

Veganic agriculture has existed for thousands of years. Veganic growing and [stockfree
organic][63] farms offer the solution to some of biggest problems facing humanity today: species
extinction, habitat loss, environmental destruction, pollution of our water and air, and soil
erosion.

World agriculture urgently needs to move towards “people nourished per hectare”. Every grower, every
seed and root planted is helping us create a clean, green and cruelty-free future! [ [Vegan Organic Network] ][1]

## Stockfree organic

**The Vegan Organic Network’s Stockfree Organic Standards **– refers to food grown professionally by
methods, which conform to the criteria and principles of [Stockfree Organic standard][66] which are
audited by the [Soil Association Certification Ltd][67] and the [OF&G][68].

#### In essence, veganic is a logical step beyond organic for those who seek safe food grown in a
#### sustainable manner.

## What is veganic?

‘Veganic’ is a combination of two words ‘vegan’ and ‘organic’.  **Veganic** also known as
**Stockfree Organic** is a guarantee that food is grown in an organic way with only plant based
fertilisers, encouraging functional biodiversity so pesticides aren’t needed.

No chemicals, no GMO and absolutely no animal by-products in any part of the chain. Animal
by-products such as bone meal, fish blood and animal faeces obtained from captive farmed animals are
still used in farming and we aim to help people switch.

Veganic agriculture has existed for thousands of years. Veganic growing and [stockfree
organic][63] farms offer the solution to some of biggest problems facing humanity today: species
extinction, habitat loss, environmental destruction, pollution of our water and air, and soil
erosion.

World agriculture urgently needs to move towards “people nourished per hectare”. Every grower, every
seed and root planted is helping us create a clean, green and cruelty-free future! [ [Vegan Organic Network] ][1]

seed and root planted is helping us create a clean, green and cruelty-free future! Take action and
join our [veganic map today.][64]

[Learn more about Veganic][65]

## Stockfree organic

**The Vegan Organic Network’s Stockfree Organic Standards **– refers to food grown professionally by
methods, which conform to the criteria and principles of [Stockfree Organic standard][66] which are
audited by the [Soil Association Certification Ltd][67] and the [OF&G][68].

#### In essence, veganic is a logical step beyond organic for those who seek safe food grown in a
#### sustainable manner.

## Why soil matters

## There will be nearly 10 billion people on the planet by 2050

Feeding everyone will require radical innovation in agriculture – while also reducing the impact on
the planet. We know this is achievable, thanks to the natural, and vital role that potassium plays
in nourishing soil and supporting plant growth.

We understand how everything is interconnected. By making better use of our natural resources, we
can support more crops, more farmers, more communities and more natural environments.

[ See our services ][18]

## At the heart of everything is always people

We want to ensure the world is fed, and we want to do this by offering opportunity to people – by
encouraging empowerment and nurturing this through skills creation and education. Through our work
with researchers and agronomists, we provide farmers with the best advice to ensure they can
maximize their potential.

Understanding this interconnectivity and balance is how we believe we can ensure shared value
creation and sustainable growth for everyone.

## Farmer focus

**Empowering farmers to deliver sustainable nutrition to a growing world**

YGO Fertilizer has a farmer-centric approach putting the farmer at the heart of all the solutions it
designs and deploys. It aims to reimagine farming to make it more resilient and more sustainable.

This requires sustainably increasing productivity of soils and crops, deploying a best-in-class

# Company Introduction

[ Yunnan Yingfu Trading Co., Ltd. (YNFERT) was established in May 2009. After 15 years of experience
in the fertilizer industry, it has become a world-renowned ammonium sulfate granular producer and
fertilizer trader. We have five plants in production with an annual production capacity of 2 million
tons, and we are continuously expanding, with two plants under construction. We are committed to
providing high-quality products and excellent services, and through our unremitting efforts, we have
established solid long-term cooperative relationships with customers around the world. Our sales
volume reached approximately 1.6 million tons in 2022 and increased to 2.4 million tons in 2023,

# Company Introduction

[ Yunnan Yingfu Trading Co., Ltd. (YNFERT) was established in May 2009. After 15 years of experience
in the fertilizer industry, it has become a world-renowned ammonium sulfate granular producer and
fertilizer trader. We have five plants in production with an annual production capacity of 2 million
tons, and we are continuously expanding, with two plants under construction. We are committed to
providing high-quality products and excellent services, and through our unremitting efforts, we have
established solid long-term cooperative relationships with customers around the world. Our sales
volume reached approximately 1.6 million tons in 2022 and increased to 2.4 million tons in 2023,
demonstrating our strong momentum of continued development. We have a joint venture factory in
Thailand, a branch in Myanmar, and overseas representative offices in Vietnam, South Korea, Brazil,
Mexico, Turkey and other places to provide localized services to customers and ensure the smooth
development of global business. YNFERT is committed to becoming your trusted supplier based on
strict quality control and a global service network. We look forward to establishing a long-term
cooperative relationship with you and developing together. ][38]
